Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps:
1. Go to https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Enter username "standard_user".
3. Enter password "secret_sauce".
4. Click Login.
Expected Result: Redirected to the Inventory page (URL contains inventory.html); product list is visible.

Title: Login fails with invalid password
Steps:
1. Enter username "standard_user".
2. Enter password "wrong_password".
3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Login is rejected. Error banner reads "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service". User remains on the login page.

Title: Login fails with invalid username
Steps:
1. Enter username "invalid_user".
2. Enter password "secret_sauce".
3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Login is rejected. Same error banner as TC-UI-02. User remains on the login page.

Title: Login fails with empty username
Steps:
1. Leave the Username field blank.
2. Enter password "secret_sauce".
3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Error banner reads "Epic sadface: Username is required".

Title: Login fails with empty password
Steps:
1. Enter username "standard_user".
2. Leave the Password field blank.
3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Error banner reads "Epic sadface: Password is required".

Title: Products are displayed on the inventory page
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Observe the inventory page.
Expected Result: At least one product card is visible (6 products total on a fresh account).

Title: Open a product's details page
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Click the "Sauce Labs Backpack" product name/image.
Expected Result: Product detail page opens; the title shown is "Sauce Labs Backpack".

Title: Products display a price
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Locate the Backpack's price on its product card.
Expected Result: A price is shown and includes a "$" symbol (e.g. "$29.99").

Title: Sort products: Name (A to Z)
Precondition: Logged in, on the inventory page.
Steps:
1. Open the sort dropdown (top right of the product list).
2. Select "Name (A to Z)".
Expected Result: Product names are listed in ascending alphabetical order, top to bottom.

Title: Sort products: Name (Z to A)
Precondition: Logged in, on the inventory page.
Steps:
1. Open the sort dropdown.
2. Select "Name (Z to A)".
Expected Result: Product names are listed in descending alphabetical order.

Title: Sort products: Price (low to high)
Precondition: Logged in, on the inventory page.
Steps:
1. Open the sort dropdown.
2. Select "Price (low to high)".
Expected Result: Products are listed in ascending price order.

Title: Sort products: Price (high to low)
Precondition: Logged in, on the inventory page.
Steps:
1. Open the sort dropdown.
2. Select "Price (high to low)".
Expected Result: Products are listed in descending price order.

Title: Add a single product to the cart
Steps:
1. Click "Add to cart" on the Backpack card.
2. Observe the cart badge.
3. Click the cart icon.
Expected Result: Cart badge shows "1". Cart page lists the Backpack.

Title: Add multiple products to the cart
Steps:
1. Click "Add to cart" on all three products.
2. Observe the cart badge.
3. Click the cart icon.
Expected Result: Cart badge shows "3". Cart page lists all three items.

Title: Cart count updates as items are added
Steps:
1. Add the Backpack; observe the badge.
2. Add the Bike Light; observe the badge.
Expected Result: Badge reads "1" after step 1, then "2" after step 2.

Title: Remove a product from the cart
Steps:
1. Add the Backpack and the Bike Light.
2. Open the cart.
3. Click "Remove" on the Backpack row.
Expected Result: Backpack is no longer listed in the cart; Bike Light is still present.

Title: Cart is empty on a new session
Steps:
1. Log in with a fresh session.
2. Observe the cart icon in the top right.
Expected Result: No cart badge is shown (or it shows a count of 0) - the cart starts empty.

Title: View an empty cart page
Precondition: Fresh login, nothing added to cart.
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Click the cart icon without adding any items.
Expected Result: Cart page loads with no items listed.

Title: Continue shopping from the cart
Steps:
1. Add the Backpack to the cart.
2. Open the cart.
3. Click "Continue Shopping".
Expected Result: User is returned to the Inventory page (URL contains inventory.html).

Title: Cart persists after navigating away and back
Steps:
1. Add the Backpack and the Bike Light.
2. Open the cart.
3. Click "Continue Shopping".
4. Click the cart icon again.
Expected Result: Both items are still present in the cart after leaving and returning to the page.

Title: Complete checkout with price verification
Test Data:
products: Backpack, Bike Light, Fleece Jacket
first/last name: any values
zip: 14108
Steps:
1. Note the listed price of the Backpack, Bike Light, and Fleece Jacket on the inventory page.
2. Add all three to the cart; confirm the badge shows "3".
3. Open the cart; confirm all three items are listed.
4. Click Checkout.
5. Fill in First Name, Last Name (any values), and Zip/Postal Code "14108".
6. Click Continue.
7. On the Overview page, add up the three prices noted in step 1.
8. Note the Item total, Tax, and Total lines.
Expected Result: Item total on the Overview page equals the sum from step 7 (within $0.01). Tax is greater than $0.00. Total equals Item total + Tax (within $0.01).

Title: Login on a mobile viewport
Precondition: Browser DevTools device toolbar (or a real device) set to a mobile viewport, e.g. iPhone 12 (390x844).
Test Data:
username: standard_user
password: secret_sauce
device: iPhone 12
Steps:
1. Open saucedemo.com in a mobile viewport.
2. Enter valid credentials.
3. Click Login.
Expected Result: Redirected to the Inventory page. Layout renders correctly at mobile width - no horizontal scrolling or broken elements.

Title: Add to cart on a mobile viewport
Test Data:
product: Sauce Labs Backpack
device: iPhone 12
Steps:
1. On a mobile viewport, log in.
2. Tap "Add to cart" on the Backpack.
Expected Result: Cart badge shows "1". Tap target is usable at mobile width (not obscured or mis-sized).
